source.title: The Korean Corpus of Spontaneous Speech
source.authors: Yun, Yoon, Park, Lee, Cho, Kang, Byun, Hahn & Kim
source.table: Table 3 — Korean phoneme set used for labeling

serialization_notes: The paper prints the three alveolopalatal affricate symbols as ʨ, ʨʰ and ʨ*. This adapter serializes ʨ as tɕ, preserving the same affricate category in the project's IPA string convention.
The paper uses an asterisk for fortis consonants (p*, t*, k*, s*, ʨ*); this adapter serializes fortisness with the IPA combining mark ͈.
This is the paper's broad phonemic inventory, not narrow phonetic transcription. It does not encode context-conditioned voicing, place variation, release detail or speaker-specific allophony.

exclusions.non_speech_markers: Labels such as <SIL>, <LAUGH>, <NOISE>, <VOCNOISE>, <IVER>, <UNKNOWN> and <PRIVATE.INFO> are excluded from IPA word scoring.
exclusions.unknown_symbols: Any non-empty phoneme-tier label absent from this mapping is excluded and counted; no guessed mapping is permitted.

usage: Research benchmark adapter only. Do not treat its scores as normative narrow-IPA accuracy or as Ukrainian target validation.
